meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 当你描述 Azure 工作负载或架构需求时,Claude 会按 7 阶段流程规划:研究最佳实践→生成基础设施计划→经你批准后产出 Bicep/Terraform,通过安全验证才部署。若涉及已有资源,先盘点并只做增量接入,不重建或改动它们。
howto.when: 当你说“规划 Azure 基础设施”“设计 hub-spoke 网络”“生成订阅级 Bicep 部署”等需求时触发。

say.text: 把这份工作负载描述变成订阅级 Bicep 部署计划。
say.note: 会先产出草案计划,经你批准后才生成 IaC。

say.text: 为我的 VM 工作负载设计 Azure Backup 与多区域容灾拓扑。
say.note: 参考 WAF 最佳实践,生成可自动验证的 IaC。

say.text: 我有现有资源组,要把新工作负载增量接入,用 Terraform。
say.note: 盘点并引用已有资源,只增量部署,不改动被引用资源。

howto.what_en: Describing an Azure workload triggers a 7-phase plan that—after your approval—generates validated Bicep/Terraform and deploys it. Referenced existing resources are inventoried, with only additive deployment; never recreated or modified.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'design hub-spoke network', or 'generate subscription-scope Bicep deployment', and similar architecture requests.

say_en.text: Turn this workload description into a subscription-scope Bicep deployment plan.
say_en.note: It drafts a plan, then pauses for your approval.

say_en.text: Design Azure Backup and a multi-region DR topology for my VM workloads.
say_en.note: Uses WAF best practices and produces validated IaC.

say_en.text: I have existing resources; add a new workload via Terraform incrementally.
say_en.note: It inventories and only adds; never alters anything.
